candidates.desc: A girl in a helmet and harness stands scared on a high rope bridge in a treetop adventure park, whispers "okay, okay" to herself, carefully steps across the swaying wire despite her fear, and reaches the wooden platform with a relieved "phew" and a smile.

A young woman on a glass skywalk high above a mountain canyon freezes in terror, gripping the railing with wide eyes and saying she can't go on. She clutches her chest, then crouches down hugging the rail post, too scared to look through the see-through floor, while a friend walks up behind her.

On a metro platform a young woman with blue hair frantically pats her pockets, dumps her tote bag on the ground to search through keys, wallet and phone, then rushes at the closing train doors and grabs her head in wide-eyed despair as the train leaves.

A young woman carrying a helmet walks up to find her white scooter lying knocked over on the pavement; she gasps, freezes with wide eyes, clutches her head with both hands and crouches over the fallen scooter in disbelief.
A cartoon office worker juggles a phone call while towers of paperwork rise around her desk; she sweats, clutches her head, cries out and finally collapses face-down on the clipboard.

High on a cliff face, a climber double-checks the knot on her rope while her belay partner waits on the ground below. After a quick "Ready?" and his "Got you!", she lets go of the rock, leans back into the rope and hangs over the huge drop with her arms spread wide, relying on him completely.

A dark bedroom at night, lit only by a small bedside lamp and the glow of a tablet. A man lies in bed under a thick cream knitted blanket watching the tablet, its light on his face, with a golden retriever lying on the bed beside him. In the lit doorway behind them a dark human figure appears and stands still, only its outline visible against the blue light of the hall. The man falls asleep with his head back and the tablet resting on his chest while the figure keeps standing there, then he is awake and watching the tablet again with the dog still beside him.

A man in a black raincoat leans into the driver's seat of an old blue car and tries to start it, dropping his head onto the steering wheel. He opens the bonnet and pokes at the battery terminals in the rain while buses pass on the wet street behind him. He gives up, closes the bonnet, leans against the car, then sits down on the kerb in the rain and covers his face with both hands.

Three shots of people and objects held up in precarious positions. A young man in black walks a slackline strung between two trees in a park, arms out to keep from falling. Then a very tall stack of wooden chairs balanced one on top of the other sways against a blue sky. Finally a group of men in black kit build a human tower, standing on each other's shoulders several levels high.

A selfie-style shot inside the dark corridor of a haunted-house attraction, the walls lined with neon strips and glowing signs. A woman with a lilac bob in a denim jacket and a man in a yellow hoodie edge forward with their eyes wide and their mouths open. A grinning zombie head lights up on the wall beside them, then a clown mask appears further down the passage. The two clutch each other, the woman gripping his arm and then his shoulder, and both scream straight into the camera as they back away.

A living room strung with fairy lights, the television on in the corner. A woman wrapped in a grey blanket walks in carrying a big bowl of popcorn. A person in an inflatable green T-rex costume rears up from behind the black sofa and lunges at her. She throws the popcorn into the air so it rains all over the floor, drops down beside the bookshelf and pulls the blanket right over her head, until only her wide frightened eyes are showing.

On a sunny street in front of a white house with a green door, red painted steps and a patterned concrete wall under pink bougainvillea, a young woman with braided hair, in a green shirt and wide black trousers with a blue backpack, clutches a clothes iron and its cord with a tense, worried face. She steps down from the door onto the steps and turns to look back at the house. By the kerb a man in a white shirt next to a cream car and a suitcase puts a hand to his head. Potted monstera plants stand by the door.

In a warm living room in the evening, a young woman in a red long-sleeved top and cream wide trousers smiles as she presses a drinking glass over a big spider on the white wall and slides a sheet of paper under it, talking calmly. Behind her a young man in a green hoodie and a young woman in a pink slip dress stand on the mustard sofa, holding on to each other, then climb down and watch nervously from behind her. Cushions lie on the floor, and a shelf with potted plants hangs above.

In a narrow corridor of an industrial building filled with flashing red light and a little smoke, a big round red alarm bell and red warning lamps glow on the white wall. A young woman in a white hard hat, navy overalls and a yellow high-visibility vest walks along the corridor towards them, then stops, stretches out her arms and shouts, directing a line of workers in hard hats and overalls who hurry along behind her. One worker carries a clipboard, and a fire extinguisher hangs on the wall.

Inside a small stone mountain hut during a snowstorm, a young woman with red braided hair, wrapped in a thick grey blanket, sits near a glowing fire. A man in a green jacket hands her a hot mug, and she holds it in both hands, closes her eyes and smiles. Hikers in snowy hoods come in through the open wooden door out of the blowing snow, and then the door is shut. A black and white sheepdog lies at her feet, jackets hang drying overhead and boots and a kettle stand by the fireplace.

A cramped student room at night. A young man in a dark red tracksuit sits at a desk with his books, gripping his hair with both hands and grimacing, and at the end slams his hands down on the books. Right behind him a young woman plays a drum kit, a young woman in a yellow hoodie runs a vacuum cleaner across the rug next to his chair, and a beagle barks up at her. A tall pile of books stands on the floor, and posters and fairy lights hang on the walls.

A young woman in a lilac puffer jacket and a red harness stands at the edge of a metal platform on a snowy stone bridge high above a rocky gorge, a bungee rope hanging below her. She leans forward with her arms stretched out as if to jump, then pulls back, straightens up and stops. A man in an orange jacket and a black beanie stands right next to her. She stares down into the deep drop and does not move, while behind the railing one friend cheers with raised fists and another holds her hands over her mouth.
